title: Gate result
description: The single JSON object a gate script prints on stdout (spec section 5.3). Gates are scripts, not prompts: this is a record of a command that actually ran, and the Reviewer agent reads it rather than re-deriving the verdict.

status.description: 'skip' means the gate did not apply here. A skip is never a pass: whether it is tolerated is decided by gates.required in thresholds.yaml.

command.description: The command actually executed. Empty when the gate skipped before running anything.

evidence_tail.description: Last few KB of the evidence, so a reader has the failure in hand without opening the file.

metrics.description: Gate-specific structured numbers: test counts, scanner statuses, coverage.
